notes.title: Ravensword: Undaunted launches in Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello there!
Ravensword: Undaunted has arrived on Steam by developer Trimatra Interactive. It's a new title in the Ravensword franchise. Please give it a look!

Trailer:
https://youtu.be/RbEWSqidzvw

Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350430/Ravensword_Undaunted/

Discord:
https://discord.gg/27ksm49G

Ravensword: Undaunted is a hexen-like shooter RPG spinoff set within the Ravensword universe focusing on dungeon crawling experience utilizing procedural levels generation from well-tuned handcrafted areas.

THE SOULBOUND ONE
Assume the role as one of the Watch Apprentice that has been inflicted by the Keep infestation. Becoming a Deathless, your soul is now bound to the devil of the Keep, thus giving you a painful endless cycle of resurrection with no end. Break the curse and earn your peace to be buried within the Hall of the Heroes.

HACK AND SLASH UNTIL IT'S DONE
With varying degrees of an arsenal left by those that once inhabited the keep, use it to overcome the vile armies or sell them for shards. Slash through hordes of undead with any Swords, Maces, and Axes you found; or outsmart them with various devastating Staves that can obliterate them in a second.

Thanks very much.
-Josh

notes.title: New update is out!
notes.notes:
Fixes an issue where the main menu buttons don't work if game controllers are 
plugged in. Please note: Game controllers are not yet supported. Keyboard and Mouse is the control method currently.

Fixes an issue with the compass background image taking up a large portion of the screen in 4:3 aspect ratio.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Ravensword: Shadowlands
notes.notes:
Ravensword: Shadowlands is Now Available on Steam!

From the award winning studio that brought you Ravensword: The Fallen King and Aralon: Sword and Shadow, comes Ravensword: Shadowlands.

After the fall of Ravengard, the world descended into chaos. The Kingdom of Tyreas stood alone against a sea of dark elven invaders. The Ravensword was lost, and the dark times began. As a descendant of an ancient line of kings, you alone have the power to wield the Ravensword again and restore that which was lost.
